name: Epochs of equal length
summary: Splits continuous M/EEG raw data into consecutive epochs of fixed duration with MNE-Python make_fixed_length_epochs and saves them as an MNE epochs file.
description: Reads an MNE raw file and cuts it into back-to-back epochs of equal length (duration in seconds) without needing events, then saves them as meg-epo.fif. Use it for resting-state or continuous recordings before spectral or connectivity analyses that work on epochs. It does not reject artifacts or apply baselines.

inputs.description: Continuous M/EEG recording in MNE raw (.fif) format.

parameters.description: Duration of each epoch in seconds.

citations.text: Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
Hayashi S., Caron B. A. et al. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
